brand_identity.name: Roobani
brand_identity.archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) infused with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) tailored for Light Theme
brand_identity.vibe: Premium private bank, bespoke design studio, highly objective, data-driven, sharp, institutional trust
brand_identity.logo: Clean minimal modern wordmark 'Roobani'. No generic up-arrows or dollar signs. Incorporate a subtle, sharp geometric growth or wealth symbol.

strict_rules: ABSOLUTELY NO em dashes (this character: u2014) anywhere in text, code, comments, alt text, or strings. Use hyphens, colons, or commas.
NO curved or rounded buttons. 0px border radius is strictly enforced across the entire application for all interactive elements.
NO AI/template/generic appearance. Must feel custom-coded and bespoke.
Objective heavy, not text heavy. Use data points, numbers, metrics, charts, icons. Minimize paragraphs to punchy statements.
All interactives MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').
No stock photos. All images to be AI generated using Gemini Nano Banana guidelines.
Strict light theme only. Do not introduce dark mode.

headings.usage: Use for H1, H2, and large impactful quotes to inject heritage and luxury.

body.usage: Use for all standard body copy, labels, and descriptions.

data_monospace.usage: Exclusively for data points, tickers, percentages, API responses, and financial metrics to emphasize precision.

spacing_scale.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates.

variants.primary: Solid Deep Navy (#1A1F3D) background, Off-white text. Hover: Sharp hover-fill sweep from left to right using a slightly lighter navy or teal accent. 0px radius.
variants.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid Deep Charcoal (#1C1C1E) border. Hover: Border changes to Warm Gold (#C9A84C) with sharp right-angled corner bracket expansions.
variants.ghost: Text-link CTA. Thick underline-reveal on hover. Sharp edges, 0px padding on x-axis.
variants.slanted: Creative variant: Parallelogram shape (skew-x) but with 0px radius corners, containing un-skewed text. Use sparingly for high-impact CTAs.

glassmorphism.usage: Use for overlapping content, sticky headers, and floating widgets.

solid.usage: Use for standard investment plan grids. Sharp neo-brutalist shadow on hover.

charts.style: Minimalist, no grid lines (or very faint dotted #E0DDD5).
charts.colors: Line charts use Warm Gold (#C9A84C) or Refined Teal (#2A9D8F). Tooltips use Glassmorphism.
charts.typography: All axis labels and tooltips MUST use JetBrains Mono.

layout_grids.home_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero splits 7 cols text, 5 cols visual. Plans grid uses 4-col spans for 3 cards.
layout_grids.data_panel: Strict 4-col grid (grid-cols-4) with 1px borders between columns acting as dividers (border-collapse style).
layout_grids.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text blocks and data. Avoid centering unless it's a massive typographic hero statement.

micro_interactions.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. No sluggish transitions. 150ms ease-in-out.
micro_interactions.data_loading: Use JetBrains Mono scrambling text effect (matrix style) before revealing final numbers.
micro_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling (Lenis) with staggered fade-up for investment cards.

landing.hero: Split hero. Left: Massive DM Serif Display heading, punchy stats in JetBrains Mono. Right: Glassmorphism card floating over an abstract AI-generated shape.
landing.ticker: Full-width marquee at the bottom of the hero. JetBrains Mono, Deep Navy background, Warm Gold text.
landing.plans_grid: 3-5 solid sharp cards. Minimal text. Huge numbers for ROI/Fees.
landing.how_it_works: 4-step process using vertical timeline with sharp square nodes. Minimalist.
landing.lead_gen: Minimalist form. Sharp input fields (0px radius, border-bottom only style).

investment_plan_detail.metrics_bar: Sticky glassmorphism bar with Fee, Min/Max Investment, Lock-in period.
investment_plan_detail.visuals: Large Recharts/Shadcn area chart (Historical) and Pie chart (Allocation) using brand palette.
investment_plan_detail.comparison: Dense, crisp data table with 1px borders. JetBrains Mono for all data cells.

auth_pages.layout: Split screen. Left: Authentication form. Right: Abstract premium generated art.
auth_pages.form: Google/Apple OAuth sharp buttons. Email/Password fields with sharp borders. Password strength indicator uses segmented sharp bars.

image_generation_prompts.prompt: Abstract geometric 3D glass shapes floating elegantly over a soft warm-white studio background. Refined lighting, subtle gold and deep navy refractions. Premium financial institution aesthetic, minimalist, sharp edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed, empty negative space for text overlay.
Macro photography of stacked premium textured paper, warm cream and deep charcoal edges. Clean architectural lines, sharp focus, luxury corporate feel, subtle teal lighting accent, depth of field.
A sharply machined metal vault mechanism, frosted glass overlay, modern minimalist aesthetic, soft lighting, warm gold highlights, depth of field, premium banking.

Minimalist architectural staircase going up, constructed from frosted glass and warm beige stone. Harsh sunlight creating sharp geometric shadows. Conceptual wealth growth, luxury, serene, highly realistic.
